藏品名称_EN: Jade arc vol. 9, compendium, paper book, private records of Confucius.
藏品名称_ZN: 玉篇巻第九残巻（自嗣字至きょう字） 紙背金剛界私記
描述_EN: A radical dictionary of Chinese characters compiled by King Goya of the Liang Dynasty in Southern China. This fragmentary scroll is on three sheets of paper, but it is a manuscript from the Tang Dynasty, and is the missing part of Volume IX of the National Treasure Tamahori in the collection of Waseda University. Since Tamahira was revised during the Song dynasty (960-1279), the manuscript from the Tang dynasty is of great value for studying the original form. The copy of Kōkai Shiki on the reverse side of the scroll, dated 121, indicates that the scroll was introduced to Japan in the mid-Heian period.
描述_ZN: 中国南朝梁王高雅编撰的激进的汉字字典。 这幅残卷虽然在三张纸上，但却是唐代的手稿，是早稻田大学收藏的国宝玉衡卷九中缺失的部分。 由于玉衡是在宋代（960-1279年）修订的，因此唐代的手稿对于研究原始形式具有重要价值。 卷轴反面的空海志副本，日期为121年，表明该卷轴是在平安时代中期传入日本的。
